annotations.title: Verify every stat in a draft

description: Paste a whole draft (up to 20,000 characters: a blog post, deck notes, an email, a social caption). Splits it into sentences, keeps each sentence that contains a number or statistic, and matches each one against the checked claims. Returns one row per statement with the numbers found, the match level, verdict, safe rephrasing and claim URL, or status not_in_database, plus counts by status and verdict. Unmatched statistic text is logged anonymously (date and text only) to guide which stats get checked next.

text.description: The draft to check, up to 20,000 characters. Longer input is cut at 20,000 characters and flagged as truncated.

name: verify_text
title: Verify every stat in a draft
